fact: LoanIQ documents a Python 3.12 research/portfolio credit-risk prototype using Pandas, SQLite, XGBoost and Streamlit, with held-out test metrics recorded in model metadata and a deterministic fact-bounded narrative layer.
notes: Use only with the repository's prototype limits. Do not represent LoanIQ as production underwriting, regulated adverse-action tooling, or independently validated credit-decision infrastructure.
limitations: Global driver ranks are not applicant-level causal explanations.
